reviews.title: Crashing slop
reviews.text: If i dare try to click edit on a photo the app crashes, plus the app gets glitchy after 500 frames and most of the editing software is useless. PLEASE fix your app.

reviews.title: Remote camera control
reviews.text: no matter what I do it won’t let me do the remote camera control option. I’ve followed all the steps and it was the only reason I downloaded this app and it gets stuck on the loading screen. I’ve tried everything. Wasted my money.

reviews.title: Repeated Glitch exit error and no clone stamp
reviews.text: I have been brushing over the rig on each frame which takes me a while per frame because of my project. There have been multiple times where the app will glitch an kick me out and therefore won’t save my progress on one of the frames unless it was completed. This app would be so much better and so much more worth it if there was a clone stamp tool as well so I wouldn’t have to go to photoshop. I would pay anything for this app to have a clone stamp tool.

reviews.title: Terrible Update
reviews.text: This used to be 5 stars easily. But the latest update made it terrible when it comes to audio. You used to be able to record dialogue as the movie played so you could time it perfectly. They took that away for some insane reason. Now you have to do work arounds like iMovie or Cap Cut to have a feature like that. There’s no more sound bar at the bottom to easily layer sound effects and music. They basically turned it into something barely better than the unpaid app. So disappointing.
